https://forums.rpgmakerweb.com/index.php?threads/galvs-message-background.47395/

You need to set the parameters for the plugin, go to the plugin settings and set the values of
Number of skins - set the total number of skins to be used in the game (all will be preloaded at the start of the game), not including the default, so for example if you have Window.png and Window_1.png you would set it to 1, if you also have Window_2.png you set it to 2 etc.
Skin var ID is the id of the variable you want to use to change the skins
In my example I set it to 4 and later I can change the window skin by changing the variable
When the value of the variable is 0 the default skin is used.
Also remember to put all your window skins in the img/system folder of your game (I think the names might be case sensitive, so capitalize the first letter, like"Window" instead of "window").
Feel free to ask any more questions if you need to
